title: Medical Emergencies in Dental and Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Practices: Analysis of Epidemiological Incidence and Structural Emergency Preparedness, and Development of an Emergency Readiness Score
summary: Anonymous questionnaires are used to survey emergencies in dental practices and assess how well these practices are prepared to handle them in terms of equipment, training, and guidelines. This allows for the identification of quality gaps.

interventions.name: The study is designed as an observational, multicenter, non-interventional cross-sectional study and is aimed at private dental and oral and maxillofacial surgery practices. The <online survey> takes about 15 minutes to complete and does not collect any personally identifiable information or IP addr
